title: Draft Pull Request Result
description: Return of the draft-pull-request agent: the pb key it was given, and the pull request title, body, labels, base branch and the coordination comment for text that is true only while the PR is open

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

title.description: Pull request title, following the configured title template

body.description: Pull request body, written for main's log after a squash-merge

labels.description: Labels to put on the pull request

base.description: Base branch the pull request targets

coordination.description: Text true only while the PR is open, posted as a comment, or null when there is none
